I am extremely disappointed with the overall experience and results delivered by HJ Talreja Interiors for my beauty store project at Kandivali East. From the start, there were continuous delays and lack of clear communication, which made the entire process stressful and frustrating.

The interior design did not align with the initial concepts discussed, and the execution fell far short of expectations. The materials used felt substandard, and many finishing details appeared rushed and unprofessional. Several elements, including lighting and storage solutions, were poorly planned and not suited to the functional needs of a beauty business.

Despite multiple follow-ups, important corrections were either delayed or completely ignored. It’s unfortunate that what was supposed to enhance the image of my business has instead created the need for additional repairs and redesign work.

I would not recommend HJ Talreja Interiors for commercial projects based on this experience. I hope they take this feedback seriously and improve their professionalism, design accuracy, and commitment to quality moving forward.

featured_reviews.name: Deepthi Jayaram
featured_reviews.review_text:
We recently got the interiors of our 3.5 BHK at Lodha New Cuffe Parade in Mumbai done by Rennovate and had a great experience overall. The team was very communicative throughout the process and did a great job understanding our ideas and translating them into practical, well-thought-out designs for the entire home, including the kitchen.

A special mention to Smita, the founder, who was personally involved and ensured our requirements were clearly understood and reflected in the design. Her inputs and attention to detail made a real difference.

The project was completed within 3 months after the design phase, as promised. We’re very happy with the overall finish and aesthetics of the final result and would definitely recommend Rennovate for home interior projects. 😊

featured_reviews.name: prateek sinha
featured_reviews.review_text:
After the purchase of her flat in Oberoi, the next big thing for us was deciding how to go about the interior designing process. We explored various options, and while researching online, we came across Rennovate’s YouTube videos showcasing their work. What really stood out to us after going through their portfolio was the sleek, elegant, and modern aesthetic they had achieved across projects. This resonated strongly with what we had in mind for our own home.
We were keen on minimalistic Scandinavian designs with a neutral colour palette. During our meeting with the team, we shared our ideas and requirements, and they helped us formalise the design in detail around the contours that we had in our mind. Not only did they incorporate our specific requirements, but they also provided valuable feedback and design enhancements, drawing on their extensive experience in handling such projects.

Post design finalisation, the execution process was seamless. They have a highly capable project team that executed the work efficiently and within the committed timelines. The entire work was completed within the 90-day timeframe after the design phase. The civil work and carpentry finishing were of very good quality, and at no point did we face any challenges with respect to execution. The materials used for the interiors were exactly as per the disclosed specifications, and we never had any concerns regarding quality.
Overall, we had a very pleasant experience working with the Rennovate Interiors team and would definitely recommend them to anyone looking to get their interiors done.
Thanks
Prateek and Neha Sinha,
Oberoi Eternia Mulund (W)

featured_reviews.name: Alok Kadam
featured_reviews.review_text:
We recently got our 2.5 BHK home renovated by Rennovate, and I must say the experience was absolutely fantastic from start to finish. A special thanks to Smitha and Kshitija for their incredible work and dedication.

What truly stood out was their professionalism and commitment to timelines—they delivered everything exactly on time without compromising on quality. The execution was brilliant, with great attention to detail in every corner of the house.

They provided us with a wide range of choices that were not only elaborate but also thoughtfully curated, making the entire decision-making process smooth and enjoyable. Their ability to understand our preferences and translate them into a beautiful, functional space was impressive.

Our home now feels exactly the way we envisioned—elegant, modern, and perfectly designed.

Highly recommend Rennovate to anyone looking for a reliable and creative interior design team!

Thank you- Jagdish and Meena Kadam

featured_reviews.name: Seema Seth
featured_reviews.review_text:
We recently had our home interiors done by Rennovate, and the results were outstanding .

Every room features artistic low-cost moulding and grooving designs that give the interiors a sophisticated and elegant look without being heavy on the budget.

The choice of laminates is exceptional — beautifully textured and perfectly coordinated with the colour scheme of each room, creating a harmonious and visually appealing atmosphere. The attention to detail, aesthetic sensibility, and craftsmanship are truly remarkable.

On top of that, the entire project was completed within the promised time frame, making the experience smooth and stress-free.

Our experience with Rennovate was excellent.

Seema

featured_reviews.name: Tamojit Mondal
featured_reviews.review_text: Thank you Smita and team for completing the interior work in our flat in a professional and timely manner. Smita is extremely diligent and careful about what her client wants and is quite thorough in her deliverables. She and her team were always helpful in assisting us with our queries, sitting with us in the design period and the execution was quite good. We had strict timeline requirements which they complied with and they have been very supportive on the post delivery service. Smita is very hands on and is very quick in her response. Overall we are quite happy with Rennovate and would recommend them to everyone for a thorough and professional work.

featured_reviews.name: Yogesh P Lad
featured_reviews.review_text:
Rennovate Interior did an excellent job with the interior design of our new home at Kalpataru Paramount, and we would highly recommend them to everyone. The entire team is outstanding, and the quality of work delivered is truly superior.

Ms. Smita (Proprietor), Ms. Shivani, Ms. Niyati, and their team executed the project very smoothly, without any complaints either from us or from our neighbors. We are extremely happy to have shortlisted such a reliable and trustworthy interior design firm.

What truly sets them apart is their prompt post-completion service. A simple message in their WhatsApp group results in an immediate response and quick resolution. Overall, a very satisfying experience (5*).

Unprofessional Interior Designer*

I hired an interior designer who promised to oversee the project from start to finish, but the experience was far from what was advertised. The designer never visited the site, despite repeated requests, and seemed more interested in taking family trips than attending to the work. Communication was sporadic, and decisions were delayed because there was no on‑site presence to assess progress or address issues.

Key points:

- No site visits throughout the project, leading to misunderstandings about measurements and material choices.
- Frequent absences while traveling, which caused significant delays.
- Limited responsiveness to emails and phone calls, making it difficult to get updates or resolve problems.
- After the final payment was made, she disappeared and kept the full amount with no refund.

Overall, the lack of professionalism and commitment made the renovation stressful and unsatisfactory. I would advise others to never hire anyone from Mansi Tarneja design house and secure a clear refund policy—before signing a contract.
